title: Strategic capacity-led OKR prioritization scorecard and cross-team deconflict runbook
creator: Arielle Chen
description:
Goal: Produce a lightweight, repeatable scorecard and runbook that helps leadership and PMs prioritize company-level initiatives against available engineering and GTM capacity. This ticket scopes the scorecard design, data sources, decision thresholds, rollout plan, and a lightweight escalation path for contested work.

Why this matters: Recent planning cycles showed recurring misalignment between ambition and available capacity (product + infra + reliability). We need a transparent, capacity-aware triage process so trade-offs are visible and decisions are defensible during roadmap commits.

Deliverables:
- Prioritization scorecard spreadsheet (rank, value, effort, risk, dependency density, compliance need) with computed signals and recommended banding.
- Runbook for cross-team deconflict: intake, triage cadence, arbitration roles, rollback criteria.
- Dashboard view (Looker/Grafana) showing capacity utilization and initiative commitments by quarter.
- Example applied case: map last quarter's three highest-risk initiatives and show how scorecard recommendations change scope or timing.

Success metrics:
- 80% of engineering leads report clarity on why top-10 initiatives were scheduled that quarter (survey).
- Reduction in post-commit scope churn by 30% quarter-over-quarter.
- Time-to-resolution for contested initiatives drops to <7 days.

Out of scope: Deep integration with payroll/resource management systems. Detailed team staffing plans (this is about capacity signals and prioritization, not headcount allocation).

Open questions:
1) Which capacity signals do we trust for short-term (1-2 quarters) vs long-term planning? (incidents, cycle velocity, reserved Dedicated capacity usage)
2) Should we weight customer/regulatory impact higher than quantitative effort in tie-breakers?
3) Who holds final arbitration for executive-level conflicts (VP of Product vs Strategy Council)?

Next steps:
- Workshop with Eng leads + Finance + GTM on 2026-03-02 to validate signals. (Artifacts: notes link below)
- Build prototype scorecard in the shared Drive and wire initial Looker tiles.
- Run pilot in Cycle 51 for a subset of initiatives and synthesize feedback by 2026-03-18.
